subject: Issue with invoice VEN010-0021 – input tax credit
body:
Dear Delta Tech & Co team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found that invoice VEN010-0021 dated 17 Sep 2025 is not shown in your return. Consequently Rs 0 ITC is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and let us know once it appears. We will hold the credit note until then.
